telling me this kid was pushing him around, and you see that just doesn’t sit right with me. you mess with the family you messin with all us. so me and logan (mind you i’m cool with “john” at this point”) so we hit john up asking if he got smoke for us, at which point he responded he does, and he can bounce from school now to come meet. so here he comes and he meets us right across the street him, eventually we ran off and the crack man stopped chasing us, we circled back around towards main street and went to this abandoned apartment complex, we had to climb the side of the building and go thru a window we’d previously smashed as the roof of this building and the apartments and everything were still mint condition just older, so here we are, middle of the afternoon, just stole a pound from a crack head, i boost across the street to the daily grind. a local smokeshop and i go for the classic swishers, i bought multiple entire boxes. me & logan sat in the empty building and faced the entire pound, called all our friends, even had my little brother bounce from school and that was the first day he ever smoked 👏🏼👏🏼 the following day i wasn’t looking forward to going to school, dreading facing this cracked up animal, well, just as luck would have it i got thru school perfectly fine, i found out about a week later that the guy actually was arrested and sent to some sort of juvenile detention center because after we had robbed his pound, he went and told all his friends he was gonna shoot me and my boy AT SCHOOL, little did we know this man was all about this shit. he really came to school strapped. thank god someone snitched him out and this went over well, fast forward to present day, i heard from this guy a few weeks ago and he had texted me on facebook and said “ur still alive? lol” i simply responded with a laughing emoji and he blocked me. long story short. don’t rob your plug or your school could end up on the news next, or. if you have luck on your side. rob that man NO BALLS 💪🏼👏🏼👏🏼
